# Source Code: Topological Sort

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Source Code: Topological Sort

Now, let's combine the logic to implement topological sorting for the graph below.

![A Directed Acyclic Graph](data:image/png;base64,)

Here's the code to implement topological sorting for the above graph:

```cpp
1vector<int> topological_sort() {
2    vector<int> indegrees(num_vertices + 1);
3    for(int i = 1; i <= num_vertices; ++i) {
4        for(auto node: adj_list[i]) {
5            ++indegrees[node];
6        }
7    }
8    queue<int> q;
9    for(int i = 1; i <= num_vertices; ++i) {
10        if(!indegrees[i]) {
11            q.push(i);
12        }
13    }
14    vector<int> sorted_vertices;
15    while(!q.empty()) {
16        int current_vertex = q.front();
17        sorted_vertices.push_back(current_vertex);
18        q.pop();
19        for(int destination_vertex: adj_list[current_vertex]) {
20            --indegrees[destination_vertex];
21            if(!indegrees[destination_vertex]) {
22                q.push(destination_vertex);
23            }
24        }
25    }
26    return sorted_vertices;
27}
```

Output

```text
2 5 1 3 4
```
